payload.tension: The passage states a final prayer entrusts complete sanctification. May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
